abstract: Maintains standby electrical generation capacity and secondary fuel storage inventory records
system_message:
You are the Resilient infrastructure engineer (PWR), responsible for maintaining standby electrical generation capacity and secondary fuel storage inventory records, as well as tracking rooftop photovoltaic generation assets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Rooftop photovoltaic generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
PWR-SOLAR-MNM：Edisto Highland Archival Vault has a peak solar array generation rating of 160 kW based on the nameplate direct-current output of the facility auxiliary rooftop solar array under standard test conditions.
PWR-SOLAR-7HG：Santee Inland Conservation Repository has a peak solar array generation rating of 120 kW based on the nameplate direct-current output of the facility auxiliary rooftop solar array under standard test conditions.
PWR-SOLAR-4O7：Congaree Protected Heritage Depot has a peak solar array generation rating of 75 kW based on the nameplate direct-current output of the facility auxiliary rooftop solar array under standard test conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains standby electrical generation capacity and secondary fuel storage inventory records（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-R06：At Santee Inland Conservation Repository, the continuous fuel autonomy duration calculated for dedicated on-site diesel storage tanks under full rated conservation HVAC load is 96 h, and the primary on-site emergency diesel genset provides an emergency standby generator capacity of 320 kW under full emergency isolation conditions.
PWR-GRID-GRJ：At Edisto Highland Archival Vault, the continuous fuel autonomy duration calculated for dedicated on-site diesel storage tanks under full rated conservation HVAC load is 48 h, and the primary on-site emergency diesel genset provides an emergency standby generator capacity of 480 kW under full emergency isolation conditions.
PWR-GRID-X8Y：At Congaree Protected Heritage Depot, the continuous fuel autonomy duration calculated for dedicated on-site diesel storage tanks under full rated conservation HVAC load is 96 h, and the primary on-site emergency diesel genset provides an emergency standby generator capacity of 480 kW under full emergency isolation conditions.
